version_note: Default source-version status applies to tables without scoped attribution. Passenger-car cold-start, evaporative and running factors originate from HBEFA 5.1, as specified by the model author on 2026-10-13. Legacy HBEFA42 filenames and 4.1 documentation do not establish versions of other tables.
multiplier_status: Retained legacy calibration; no independent empirical validation recovered.

scoped_sources.reference: the original LCA model, carculator, uses emission factors for cold start, evaporative and running emissions from the HBEFA 5.1 emissions handbook.
scoped_sources.scope: Passenger-car cold-start, evaporative and running emission factors; no coefficient changes.

extraction_notebook: carculator_truck/dev/HBEFA trucks.ipynb references the recovered EFA_HOT_Subsegm_HGV.XLSX; workbook properties have no version. Its polynomial-fit exploration is not a reproducible derivation of all shipped g/MJ coefficients.
extraction_status: Passenger-car cold-start, evaporative and running factors: HBEFA 5.1 source attribution supplied by the model author on 2026-10-13. Local truck and bus workbooks recovered; their extraction version and transformation to all shipped coefficients remain unverified.

evaporative_speciation.policy: Separate soak, diurnal and running losses from exhaust speciation. Retain process-specific benzene and subtract it once from generic NMVOC; leave other evaporative NMHC unspecified.
evaporative_speciation.scope: The car family currently supplies the non-exhaust table. Hot and cold-start factors and exhaust profiles are unchanged.
evaporative_speciation.qualification: Cold-start, evaporative and running factors originate from HBEFA 5.1. No new complete evaporative species profile is introduced. This policy does not reconcile the separate directly tabulated exhaust-benzene factor with exhaust NMHC.

cold_start_audit.policy: Per-start g/start and hot-soak g/stop factors multiplied by starts_per_day * 365 / annual_km; diurnal and running losses unchanged.
cold_start_audit.decision: User selected revised Swiss 2020 start count on 2026-10-13; retain current annual mileage defaults (12000 km for combustion cars).
cold_start_audit.source_locator: Table 3-90, p.167, passenger cars, 2020 column; 1.8 starts per vehicle per day.
cold_start_audit.speciation_locator: Update June 2026, Table 3-86d, p.107: Euro 6 petrol formaldehyde fraction 1.70% of NMVOC; unchanged in this model.
cold_start_audit.qualification: Cold-start, evaporative and running factor source attribution is specified by the model author. Detailed country, temperature, parking-time and trip-length settings are not separately recorded in this repository. CH thermal settings do not recompute this shared table. The confirmation does not cover every vehicle-family factor table, speciation fraction or manual multiplier.
